notes.title: Exciting Updates for The Vengeance Of Lady Witch
notes.notes:
Greetings, The Vengeance Of Lady Witch Community

We're thrilled to announce some exciting new updates for The Vengeance Of Lady Witch. Your feedback has been invaluable, and we've been hard at work making improvements to enhance your gaming experience. Here's what's new:

1. Skill and Attack Sound Customization:
You can now tailor the sounds of your character's skills and attacks to your liking by configuring them through the BGM Volume settings. Make every battle feel unique with the power of personalized sound effects!

2. Invisible Cursor in Gameplay:
Say goodbye to distractions! We've made the cursor invisible during gameplay to keep you fully immersed in the world of 'The Vengeance Of Lady Witch.' However, if you pause the game by pressing the 'ESC' key, please refrain from clicking the close button. Instead, press 'ESC' again to prevent the cursor from reappearing. If you happen to see the cursor reappear, simply press 'ESC' again, and then close it by pressing 'ESC' once more.

3. New Quest Log UI:
We've overhauled the quest log interface with a focus on clarity and detail. Get a better understanding of your quests, objectives, and progress to make your adventures even more epic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081243/8995be4b3f55b0cd4b9059ea879a448485ca4d52.jpg[/img]

4. Smooth Prologue-to-Gameplay Transition:
We've worked on creating a seamless transition between the prologue and gameplay, ensuring your journey is as smooth as possible.

5. Side Panel Bug
Since we've fixed the cursor invisibility issue, we've disabled the buttons on the side panel. However, we've kept the UI intact to provide guidance and explanations for key functions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081243/91cd6dd4261c45c868793a2e3f9bf82b2d9c4a55.jpg[/img]

These updates are a testament to our commitment to delivering the best possible gaming experience. We hope you enjoy them as much as we enjoyed bringing them to you.

Your feedback continues to be a driving force behind our development, so please keep it coming. Together, we'll make [Your Game Name] even more incredible.

Thank you for your ongoing support, and happy gaming!

**Escort Mission 1 - Protect The Caravan:**
In this thrilling new quest, you will take on the responsibility of protecting a valuable caravan as it journeys from the Fisherman Village to the Village of safety. Beware of enemy attacks along the way, as they seek to disrupt the caravan's progress. Your mission is clear: ensure the caravan's safe passage to its destination.

**Quest Details:**
- Escort the caravan and defend it against enemy attacks.
- Safely guide the caravan from Fisherman Village to the Village.
- Quest is repeatable for endless challenges.
- In case of failure, the system will automatically restart the quest, providing you with another chance to succeed.

notes.title: New Hair Color and Eyes Updated! The Vengeance Of Lady Witch
notes.notes:
Hey there, fellow adventurers of The Vengeance Of Lady Witch crew!

Hold onto your wizard hats because we've got something seriously awesome coming your way. You spoke, and we listened – get ready to pimp up your gameplay with some fresh new looks that'll make your character stand out like a fire-breathing dragon in a snowstorm. Introducing not one, not two, but three rad eye colors – think bold blues, intense reds, and mysterious grays. And that's not all – prepare to rock the realm with a sleek silver hairdo that screams "I'm here to slay!"

What’s the Buzz:

👀 Eyes of Awe: Ever wished your character could gaze upon enemies with eyes as blue as the sky, red as a raging inferno, or cool gray as an impending storm? Well, now you can! Customization just hit a whole new level.



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081243/4393f0223a22ebe44a5d42d098fffa9a71ef245d.jpg[/img]



💁 Silver Fox Vibes: Your character's hair deserves some love too, right? We're unlocking the silver hair color, adding a touch of sophistication to your in-game persona. You'll be looking fly while tossing spells and battling beasts!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081243/a40fefe041e4b303e7f0136ece440211699edcb2.jpg[/img]

🌟 How to Make It Yours: 🌟
Ready to level up your character's style? Follow these steps:

Fire up The Vengeance Of Lady Witch on Steam.
Dive into the character customization section – you know the drill.
Say hello to the snazzy new eye and hair colors waiting for your creative touch.
Mix and match to craft an avatar that's as unique as you are.
Wait, there's more! We've also been working behind the scenes, squashing bugs, and enhancing performance so your gameplay is smoother than a magic carpet ride.

You legends have been our guiding stars, and we can't thank you enough. The world of The Vengeance Of Lady Witch just got a whole lot bigger, and it's all thanks to you.

Ready to level up your adventure? Get in there and start slinging spells with your fresh new look. Oh, and don't forget to snap some screenshots of your epic battles and drop them right here on the Steam Community Hub!

Wishing you crits, epic loot, and some seriously wicked gaming sessions!

Kind regards

notes.title: Customize The Character [ The Vengeance Of Lady Witch]
notes.notes:
Yo, our Witcher Mania crew! We're back and pumped up as we draw closer to the epic release date! Man, we're working our tails off to make this game rock!

Now, get ready for some awesome news. Buckle up as we spill the beans on one of the coolest features in our game - customizing your very own Witcher character!

Behold, "The Vengeance Of Lady Witch" grants you the power to personalize your character's look. You can now style their costume and switch up their hair color, but hold up, you'll need some gold to make it happen! Gold can be earned by completing quests, snatching it from the wicked monsters you slay, or simply selling your loot in the shop.

Alright, here's the drill: press that sleek V key on your keyboard, and bam! The customize panel will pop up like magic, just like the image below.

So, gear up, witches and witchers, 'cause you're about to create some legendary looks! Get ready to slay monsters and look fab doing it. Stay tuned for more wicked updates, and we'll see you in the game! Peace out!

notes.title: Quest System [ The Vengeance Of Lady Witch ]
notes.notes:
Hi, Witcher Mania! We have written a new game guide topic for our game, "The Vengeance of Lady Witch." Since "The Vengeance of Lady Witch" is an Action RPG game, it's evident that there are numerous quests to complete in order to progress through the game, earn experience points, level up, and obtain various rewards such as status upgrades, skill points, and even gold, which can be used to purchase items, costumes, or even change your character's hair color!

[b][h2]Take Quests from NPCs and Report Back Upon Completion[/h2][/b]

To embark on quests and advance in the game, you can acquire quests from various non-player characters (NPCs) within the game. These quests serve to fulfill the main objectives of the game or may simply offer rewards (repeatable quests). Once you have fulfilled all the requirements outlined by the NPC, you must return to them and report that you have completed the quest. This marks the quest as finished, and you will receive your rewards accordingly.

[b][h2]Multiple Quests[/h2][/b]

In this game, you have the freedom to undertake multiple quests simultaneously. Even if you have an ongoing quest from NPC A, you can still accept a quest from NPC B. Please refer to the image below for a visual representation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081243/e9f44c3f8a626b7d9ec6fb3e90f2f992b34c9773.jpg[/img]

That concludes our guide on the Quest System! Enjoy your gaming experience!

notes.title: Save System
notes.notes:
Dear Witcher Mania,

In this post, we'd like to explain the save system in our game so that you won't accidentally lose your saved data.

In "The Vengeance Of Lady Witch," you'll embark on quests to earn experience points, level up your character, improve your abilities, and learn new skills. That's why we highly recommend saving your achievements regularly, so you don't have to repeat them and waste your time. To save your game during gameplay, simply press the ESC button. The pause menu will appear, and you'll find the SAVE button there. Refer to the detailed image below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081243/e88e83e91a18e2dc3ed411ce5878cd38a800ed98.jpg[/img]

If you want to continue your journey after quitting the game, please refrain from clicking the "New Game" button on the Main Menu scene. Doing so will automatically delete all your saved data, and you'll have to start from the beginning. Instead, kindly click the "Load Game" button, and you'll be taken to the last saved point in your game. Please refer to the detailed description of the Main Menu buttons below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081243/b4c766024609b1dea58aea130daf0016e43f9cad.jpg[/img]

Thank you for your attention and happy gaming!

Best regards,
MonoCG Studio

notes.title: Player Controller & Feature Panel
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081243/1e510d2506fca37f4f0294bccfdf349b9bc12ba0.jpg[/img]

Dear Witcher Mania! Welcome to “The Vengeance Of Lady Witch”, an exciting adventure where you take control of a brave hero on a quest to save the world from the Dark Knight. In this game, you'll be using your PC keyboard to navigate through various challenges and overcome obstacles. Let's dive into the player controller and get you ready for your epic journey!

First, let's familiarize ourselves with the basic movement controls. You'll be using the arrow keys or the WASD keys on your keyboard to move your character around the game world. Pressing the up or W key will make your character move forward, down or S key will move them backward, and the left or A key will move them to the left, while the right or D key will move them to the right. Great! Now that you know how to move, let's talk about some additional actions you can perform. To interact with objects or talk to non-player characters, you can use the spacebar key. Pressing the spacebar will allow you to open doors, pick up items, or engage in conversations with other characters in the game.

Next, we have the jump mechanic. You can make your character jump by pressing the “Space” key. Jumping will help you navigate over gaps, reach higher platforms, and avoid obstacles in your path.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081243/9ae6fe58e98193806a84dec930a2e35362189641.png[/img]


To summon your trusted steed, simply press the 'G' key on your keyboard. Once your horse has arrived, you can mount it by approaching it and pressing the 'E' key. This will allow you to climb onto the saddle and prepare for your ride. When you do, a majestic horse will appear by your side, ready to carry you on your travels.


Open the side panel to access the inventory, skill tree, quest, and player status by pressing the ‘H’ key. But if you want to access them directly, you can press the following key :



1. Inventory = I Key

You can manage your items and equipment in this panel. Make sure you have everything you need before proceeding to finish your quest.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081243/e7105e67dddcb50a1e861bad28d6eb0b9524cefe.png[/img]


2. Skill Tree = K Key

You can manage your learned skills in this panel. Add new skills by using points you will receive after completing your quests. We will update the Skill Tree Panel image as soon as possible!


3. Player Stats = C Key

Manage your attack and defense points on this panel

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081243/2d9e3e96102840b8d72f8c8abe6b32ff1cf561a7.png[/img]

4. Quest = Q Key

Your mission details will appear on this panel, so make sure you have completed all the objectives

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081243/b3a68aeb402dfb76db42b412212d8b9221012e52.png[/img]


5. Player Customize = V Key

You can purchase new clothing and equip it to the player through this panel

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081243/b5c52857178801c3b12b465c79ef31442f071e0e.png[/img]


6. Turn On/Off Minimap = M Key

Toggle the Minimap on/off on the screen

7. Interact = E Key

You can use this key not only to ride a horse but also to interact with citizens or any objects


8, Option = ESQ

You can adjust the BGM volume and save/load the game through this panel

9. Use Skill = 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 Key

There are 8 button fields available for using skills. Press the corresponding number key to activate the skill you want to use


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081243/e55d6e04c2f2121a56805cbce80c409f948211f5.png[/img]

And there you have it! You're now familiar with the player controller using your PC keyboard in The Vengeance Of Lady Witch. With these controls at your fingertips, you're ready to embark on an unforgettable adventure. Good luck and enjoy your journey!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44081243/90806c8a3f3602d5fe1153aaea7984bcd9d12ce4.png[/img]
